jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer, Fedcap Rehab Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

About The Fedcap Group

The Fedcap Group is a global nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing economic mobility, workforce development, education, and health through innovative, evidence-based solutions. Serving more than 332,000 people annually across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, The Fedcap Group partners with government, employers, healthcare organizations, educational institutions, and community leaders to improve lives and strengthen communities.

Position Summary

The Chief Operating Officer, Fedcap Rehabilitation Services, is the senior executive responsible for leading the operational strategy, performance, and growth of Fedcap Rehabilitation Services, one of The Fedcap Group's largest organizations. Reporting to the President of Fedcap Rehabilitation Services. the COO provides executive leadership across a diverse portfolio of Total Facilities Management operations, revenue-generating and government-funded programs, workforce development initiatives, vocational rehabilitation services, and core operational functions that drive organizational performance while advancing the organization's mission and long-term sustainability.
The COO is responsible for translating strategic priorities into operational execution while driving growth, operational excellence, financial performance, exceptional service delivery, and customer satisfaction. This executive partners closely with the executive leadership team to strengthen organizational capabilities, expand strategic partnerships, foster innovation, and position the organization for sustainable growth and long-term impact.
The successful candidate is a seasoned operational leader with a proven track record of leading complex, multi-site organizations and large-scale Total Facilities Management operations. Experience should include facilities and engineering operations, building systems, janitorial services, property management, office services, print and mail operations, business solutions, or similar customer-focused service environments. The ideal candidate has successfully driven operational excellence, innovation, financial performance, and customer satisfaction across private, government, or other highly regulated sectors while advancing organizational mission and community impact.

Executive Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Organizational Strategy

Partner with the President to establish and execute the organization's strategic vision, operational priorities, and long-term growth strategy.
Provide executive leadership across all operational functions to ensure organizational alignment, accountability, and execution.
Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, and data-informed decision making.
Lead organizational transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, service quality, and business performance.
Establish performance expectations, monitor key metrics, and ensure achievement of operational and financial objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the President, Board, and executive leadership team on operational strategy, business performance, and organizational opportunities.

Program Operations & Service Delivery

Oversee the performance, quality, and operational effectiveness of a diverse portfolio of Total Facilities Management operations, workforce development, vocational rehabilitation, and related service programs.
Ensure consistent execution of programs while improving customer experience, operational efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
Monitor operational performance through data, KPIs, and quality measures to drive continuous improvement.
Foster collaboration across operational teams to ensure consistent service delivery and organizational effectiveness.

Government Contracts, Compliance & Quality

Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, local, contractual, regulatory, and accreditation requirements.
Oversee quality assurance, risk management, contract performance, and operational compliance across the organization.
Promote a culture of accountability, ethical leadership, and continuous quality improvement.

Business Growth & Strategic Partnerships

Support organizational growth through operational expansion, innovation, and strategic initiatives.
Build and strengthen strategic partnerships that enhance organizational performance, business development, and community impact.
Collaborate with executive leadership to identify new opportunities that advance the organization's mission and long-term sustainability.
Represent the organization with key external stakeholders to strengthen partnerships, expand opportunities, and advance organizational objectives.

Financial & Operational Excellence

Partner with finance leadership to develop and manage operating budgets while ensuring strong financial stewardship.
Drive operational productivity, resource optimization, and financial performance across the organization.
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual budget reviews.
Monitor organizational performance using data and operational metrics to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and long-term sustainability.
Ensure operational resources, systems, and infrastructure support continued organizational growth.

People Leadership & Organizational Culture

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing executive and operational leadership team.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Build organizational capability through leadership development, succession planning, and talent optimization.
Champion employee engagement while reinforcing The Fedcap Group's mission, values, and culture.
Partner with the Board of Directors and executive leadership to advance the organization's strategic priorities and mission.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred in Business or a related Human Services field.
Ten or more years of executive leadership experience leading and scaling complex organizations, preferably in both commercial and mission-driven environments.
Extensive executive leadership experience managing large-scale Total Facilities Management operations or similarly complex service organizations, including facilities management, engineering systems, building operations, janitorial services, property management, office services, print and mail operations, business solutions, or related operational functions.
Demonstrated success driving business growth, operational excellence, financial performance, customer experience, and organizational transformation.
Strong business and financial acumen with experience operating across diverse business and funding models.
Proven ability to develop high-performing leadership teams and lead organizations through growth, change, and continuous improvement.
Experience overseeing complex operations, regulatory compliance, quality, risk management, and operational performance.
Demonstrated success building strategic partnerships that advance organizational performance and growth.
Exceptional executive presence with outstanding communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills.

What Success Looks Like

High-performing Total Facilities Management, rehabilitation, and workforce development operations that consistently achieve operational, contractual, and financial goals.
Strong financial stewardship and effective management of organizational resources.
Exceptional program quality, regulatory compliance, and performance outcomes.
Trusted partnerships with government agencies, employers, educational institutions, customers, and community organizations.
Engaged, accountable, and high-performing operational leadership team.
Innovative, participant-centered programs and operational services that improve employment outcomes, customer satisfaction, and advance economic mobility.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation: $200,000-$250,000 Annually
Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision | Life/AD&D & Long-Term Disability | Flexible Spending Account (FSA) | Commuter Benefits | 403(b) | Wellness Program

The Fedcap Group
provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We are an EEO employer committed to diversity, M/F/D/V.
About Us

Mission:
To create opportunities for people with barriers to economic well-being.
In 1935, Fedcap Rehabilitation Services was founded by three men in NYC who had sustained injuries in WWI and literally changed the world for people with physical disabilities. It now provides an array of services to youth and adults helping thousands each year graduate from high school, obtain vocational certification or a college degree, become work ready, obtain meaningful employment and achieve long term economic well-being.
Renamed The Fedcap Group in 2018, Fedcap Rehabilitation Services continues to be a trailblazer in providing opportunities for people with challenges and disabilities and their families.

jobs.title: Director of Communications And Public Relations
jobs.description:
Public Relation Director
Job description:
We are seeking a Public Relation Director to join Southern Brooklyn Council Member. The
position will help develop and execute effective communications strategies that support
Council Member’s priorities. She/He will collaborate with staff in the office of Council
Member, and staff from the Legislative, Land Use and Finance divisions. The role will be
responsible for developing messaging, drafting talking points and press materials (op-eds,
press releases, etc.), and managing media relations. press conferences, developing media
strategies and responding to breaking news. This person also assists the Council Member
in drafting speeches, op-ed articles, columns and letters to the editor, coordinates web
content management training sessions and assists Council Member with strategies across
all media platforms.

SALARY RANGE:
$80,000 to $100,000
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Support the development and implementation of comprehensive communications
strategies that elevate and advance Council member’s priorities.
• Manage communications support for assigned Council Member and committees,
coordinating closely with Member’s Staff.
• Serve as a key point of contact for reporters covering Council and related policy
areas, building and maintaining strong media relationships.
• Draft, review, and edit press materials, including press releases, media advisories,
briefing papers, talking points, and statements.
• Assist in planning and execution of press events for the Councilmember.
• Pitch media stories and coverage opportunities to reporters in collaboration with
senior communications staff.
• Coordinate and staff media interviews for Council Member, ensuring preparation
and message alignment.
• Provide general communications support and undertake special projects as
assigned.

Media Inquiries & Relationship Management
• Ensure timely, accurate, and well-coordinated responses to all incoming media
inquiries, tracking engagement across the press team.
• Manage press engagement by synthesizing inquiries, consulting with relevant staff,
and ensuring responses are thorough, strategic, and aligned with Council
messaging.
• Serve as a primary spokesperson for ethnic media outlets, effectively
communicating key messages and perspectives.
• Lead and support rapid response efforts to ensure the Council’s voice is
represented in breaking news coverage.
• Cultivate and maintain relationships with key media contacts across local, national,
and ethnic outlets.
• Support stakeholder engagement and relationship-building with internal teams,
government partners, and external organizations
Planning & Coordinating Press Events and Opportunities
• Coordinate logistics for the Council Member’s press conferences and events,
including media outreach, run-of-show development, participant preparation, and
execution.
• Develop and distribute press materials and messaging, ensuring consistency and
clarity across all communications.
• Identify and secure proactive media opportunities, including interviews, feature
stories, and op-eds for the Council Member.
• Oversee interview preparation and coordination for Council leadership and external
validators.
Advancing Communications Strategy
• Serve as a strategic communications partner in developing and executing initiatives
that advance the Council member’s legislative and policy priorities.
• Contribute to the development of messaging frameworks and communications
tactics targeting diverse audiences across New York City.
• Design and implement integrated public affairs campaigns utilizing a mix of media,
digital, and multimedia strategies.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of progressively responsible experience in
communications, media relations, public affairs, or a related field.
• Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability
to engage effectively with media and stakeholders.
• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage
multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated sound judgment, with strong analytical, creative, and problem-
solving abilities.

• Ability to work flexible, non-traditional hours, including early mornings, evenings,
weekends, and holidays as needed.
• Bilingual proficiency is highly preferred.
• In person only
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
New York City residency required within 90 days of appointment.
For eligible employees, health, dental and vision insurance coverage are offered upon hire.
Retirement plans, deferred compensation plans, group life insurance, paid time off and
paid holidays, training resources, health & fitness reimbursement and wellness programs
are also available.
The New York City Council makes reasonable accommodation for applicants and
employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the
job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive
other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact EEOOfficer@council.nyc.gov.
HOW TO APPLY:
Qualified candidates should forward their cover letter indicating your match to the stated
job requirements; your resume; and a writing sample (e.g., traditional/digital/social media
content) to:
E-MAIL: szhuang@council.nyc.gov
While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an
interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Development, Herbert Wertheim College of Business
jobs.description:
Department

FSU Division of University Advancement

Florida State University is currently in the leadership phase of a comprehensive campaign. As the leadership phase of the campaign begins, the Division of University Advancement is accelerating the hiring of additional development officers’ campus-wide and is excited to build out its team. For Advancement professionals who are interested in being a part of a comprehensive campaign from the beginning for their career development, the timing is ideal to join our team.

Responsibilities

The Senior Director of Development strategically designs and executes a personal solicitation program resulting in philanthropic support through the identification, cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of high-level prospects for the Herbert Wertheim College of Business. The Senior Director of Development secures, on an annual basis, private support at the major gift level ($100,000) while also identifying, developing and managing a portfolio primarily consisting of $1,000,000 and above donors. The Senior Director of Development will be expected to uphold and exemplify the operating practices of the Division of University Advancement while raising philanthropic dollars in support of the mission of Florida State University.

Strategic Fundraising Development

Serving as the chief strategist, develops, oversees and coordinates the fundraising plans of the College with the Dean and the Associate Vice President, Colleges, Schools and Units. Identifies, qualifies and sustains a donor prospect pipeline and portfolio with a giving capacity of $100,000 or more, while concentrating on the development of major and principal gift prospects at the $1,000,000 and up level. Provides oversight and assistance in the determination of the feasibility and type of giving vehicle best suited to the needs of the donor, the Herbert Wertheim College of Business and the University. Prepares prospect materials for the President of the University, the Vice President, the Associate Vice President, the Dean and other senior administration as appropriate to a prospect’s situation.

Effectively communicates FSU’s mission and represents the FSU’s culture to external stakeholders.

Travels frequently to meet with alumni, parents, faculty, staff and friends of FSU.

Management

Supervises and assists in the professional development and mentoring of the Herbert Wertheim College of Business fundraising staff, to include the monitoring of fundraising metrics. Leads staff in establishing a strong philanthropic focused and supportive work environment in alignment with the FSU’s operating principles. Facilitates the development, maintenance and monitoring of strategically aligned staff work plans. Responsible for cost center budget development and management, including expense reports under the direction of the Associate Vice President of Advancement, Colleges, Schools and Units.

Administrative/Events

Facilitates meetings, initiating up to date communications, informational exchanges and project / philanthropic coordination with the faculty and faculty chairs. Prepares correspondence with prospects and all contact reporting in a professional and timely manner. Maintains donor interest and enthusiasm through stewardship activities. Prepares proposals and gift agreements as required for proper gift documentation. Reviews gift agreements for proper gift documentation.

Board/Volunteer Management

Designs and develops a volunteer structure in support of the Herbert Wertheim College of Business’ fundraising efforts. Ensures direct activities with prospects are designed to enhance the affiliation between the prospect and the University.

Central Development Collaboration

Coordinates with the Division of University Advancement colleagues to identify prospects for planned giving, corporate and foundation giving in partnership with the Office of University Research, and principal giving in partnership with the Principal Gifts Team. Protects confidential information. Perform other related duties as required and assigned.

Qualifications

Master's degree and four years of experience in a related advancement field or a Bachelor's degree and six years of related experience. Higher education can substitute for experience at a comparable rate.

A valid Florida Driver's License or the ability to obtain upon hire.

University Information

One of the nation's elite research universities, Florida State University preserves, expands, and disseminates knowledge in the sciences, technology, arts, humanities, and professions, while embracing a philosophy of learning strongly rooted in the traditions of the liberal arts and critical thinking. Founded in 1851, Florida State University is the oldest continuous site of higher education in Florida. FSU is a community steeped in tradition that fosters research and encourages creativity. At FSU, there’s the excitement of being part of a vibrant academic and professional community, surrounded by people whose ideas are shaping tomorrow’s news!

Learn more about Florida State University and our campuses.

FSU Total Rewards

FSU offers a robust Total Rewards package. Visit our FSU Total Rewards website to learn more about our Compensation, Benefits, Wellness, Recognition, and Employee Development programs.

Use our FSU Total Compensation Calculator to calculate Total Compensation options based on potential salary, benefits and retirement contributions, earned leave, and other employment-related perks.

How To Apply

If qualified and interested in a specific job opening as advertised, apply through the FSU Careers site (jobs.fsu.edu). If you are a current FSU employee, apply through myFSU Self Service.

Applicants are required to complete the online application with all applicable information. Applications must include all work history up to ten years, and education details even if attaching a resume.

Considerations

This is an A&P position.

This position requires successful completion of a criminal history background check.

This role requires driving and travel.

This position is being advertised as open until filled.

Equal Employment Opportunity

FSU is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
